notes.title: Update 1.1 - Steam Integration and Code Editor improvements
notes.content:
🚀 Patch Notes – Update v1.1
Thanks to the incredible feedback from our community, we’ve rolled out a new patch to squash bugs, enhance the gameplay experience, and introduce some much-requested improvements.

🔐 New Features
Steam Login Integration
You can now log in using your Steam account for a smoother and more secure experience.

🧠 Code Editor Improvements

 Instruction and output panels are now expandable.
 Added Ctrl + C support to copy code from the editor.
 You can now paste code into editable (blue) cells using Ctrl + V.
 Undo/Redo functionality added via buttons or Ctrl + Z / Ctrl + Y.
 Tab autocomplete is now supported for smoother coding.
 Mouse support added to select and apply code suggestions.



🎮 Gameplay & Mission Updates
Mission 2 Fixes
All cameras are now hackable as intended—no more mission blockers.

Reduced Cutscene Skip Time
You can now skip cutscenes faster, making repeat playthroughs much smoother.

🖱️ UI & Controls
Main Menu UI Tweaks
Small adjustments to make navigation more intuitive.

Camera Movement Fixes
Fixed an issue on certain hardware where switching between cameras caused erratic or ultra-fast movement.

Mouse Cursor Bug Fix
Resolved the issue where the cursor would stick to the center of the screen under specific conditions.

Audio Transition Fixes
Eliminated sudden volume spikes when switching scenes.

📦 Performance & Backend
Optimized Course Data Fetching
Backend changes to reduce loading delays and improve responsiveness.

Code Optimization
Reduced FPS drops during autosaves and at the end of Mission 1.

Thank you for playing and supporting us! Keep the feedback coming and stay tuned for more exciting updates ahead.

notes.title: Patch 1.1 — First Update!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Thank you for jumping into our Early Access launch. We’ve been closely listening to your feedback and reports, and this first patch brings key fixes and polish across core game play, UI, and performance.


🔧 Fixes & Improvements

Fixed input lag and stutter issues on high-end PCs
Mouse movement and animation timing now behave smoothly across a wider range of hardware.

Gun play improvements
Adjusted firing responsiveness and bullet behaviour to make shooting feel tighter and more satisfying.

Improved player movement
Movement has been smoothed out to feel more responsive and fluid during exploration and combat.

Code editor fix
Fixed an issue where pressing Shift + Enter in the in-game code editor caused input problems.

Minor UI tweaks
Cleaned up some inconsistent visuals and improved UI transitions for better readability.

Splash screen polish
Enhanced visuals and loading behaviour during the initial game launch.

Better camera switching
Camera transitions between modes while hacking cameras are now more seamless and visually consistent.

Audio improvements
Adjusted volume levels, spatial audio positioning, and reduced overlapping sounds in certain scenes.

Single-instance enforcement
Prevented multiple instances of the game from running simultaneously to avoid accidental overlaps or crashes.

Save System Overhaul

Reworked the save system to avoid false Trojan detections from some antivirus software (e.g., Kaspersky). The new system reduces file write frequency, preventing false positives while improving save performance.
[hr][/hr]
This is just the beginning — we’re working hard on bigger content and features for future updates.
Keep sharing your thoughts and bug reports on the community hub or our Discord!

Discord

Thank you for being part of this journey!
– Team CodingKraft
